# Parse the old songs list from the file content.
import re

content = _mem['s13']['content']
lines = [line.strip() for line in content.splitlines() if line.strip().startswith('- ')]
old_songs = []
for line in lines:
    # Remove leading "- " and split on " by "
    line = line[2:].strip()
    if ' by ' in line:
        title, artists_str = line.split(' by ', 1)
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
        old_songs.append({'title': title.strip(), 'artists': artists})
    else:
        # If no " by ", treat whole as title
        old_songs.append({'title': line, 'artists': []})

print(f"Parsed {len(old_songs)} old songs:")
for s in old_songs:
    print(s)
